text: The idea is good but the execution is a bit lacking in the most essential parts such as the task list and dailies. This app is not ideal for those with bad internet connection such as myself who usually only has access to a phone. I returned after a long break only to not have noticed much improvement at all and the only reason I'd want to stick with it are the community and the gamefied system. Also please do something about the completed tasks appearing even after being marked.
